questions.question: In a certain code language, 'do or die' is written as 'su ru ko', 'let us do it' is written as 'ko mo yo zu' and 'this or that' is written as 'ga tu ru'. How will 'die' be written in that language?
questions.solution:
The logic followed hers is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab3428e49b6833afa8313df80301e561fefdad8d0ea9000ec35a7920357ec11f.png] 

Code of **or** → ru

Code for **do** → ko

∴ Here, 'die' is coded as 'su'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"su".**

questions.question: In a certain code, 692425 means 'School education is free in India' and 7926 means 'College education is costly'. Which of the following is the code for 'I want to become graduate'?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

**Logic : Digits represent the number of letter in a single word in the serial order of the sentence.**

So,

 
• 692425 means 'School education is free in India'

⇒ School → 6 letters word

⇒ education → 9 letters word

⇒ is → 2 letters word

⇒ free → 4 letters word

⇒ in → 2 letters word

⇒ India → 5 letters word

 
• 7926 means 'College education is costly'

⇒ College → 7 letters word

⇒ education → 9 letters word

⇒ is → 2 letters word

⇒ costly → 6 letters word

Similarly, 

 
• 'I want to become graduate'​

⇒ I → 1 letter word

⇒ want → 4 letters word

⇒ to → 2 letters word

⇒ become → 6 letters word

⇒ graduate → 8 letters word

Hence, **"****14268"** is the correct answer.
